in_hebrew.name: Grevera
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Grevera הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'greos' meaning 'strong' and 'pastor' meaning 'shepherd'. Grevera embodies the strength and nurturing qualities of a devoted shepherd, caring for and guiding her flock.

in_greek.name: Grevera

Grevera embodies the strength and nurturing qualities of a devoted shepherd, caring for and guiding her flock.

in_latin.name: Grevera
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong shepherd

Grevera embodies the strength and nurturing qualities of a devoted shepherd, caring for and guiding her flock.
